pr.conversion: daily flux x 86400, summed over calendar year

aggregation: For each model and year, nearest paired NEX grid cell to registered coordinates; complete daily years only; equal mean across years per model, then equal mean across models.

excluded_models.reason: Historical source retrieval incomplete for the configured 1995-2014 interval (missing MRI-ESM2-0 historical precipitation/temperature years 2013-2014 and temperature 2012).

limitations: Four of five configured model series are included. MRI-ESM2-0 is excluded rather than filled because its historical 1995-2014 source is incomplete.
NASA POWER observations are not used in this comparison; both periods use the same NASA NEX model product to avoid mixing observational and model baselines.
The comparison is not a forecast or field-level estimate; model means and spread are descriptive, not probabilities.
A 12-year matched subperiod check is preserved for sensitivity, but the full 20-year result above is the primary comparison.
